note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on choosing between OAuth 2.0 flows (JWT Bearer, Client Credentials, Authorization Code) for integration scenarios, and why Username-Password is discouraged. Taught through narrative comparison and a flow-selection scenario rather than screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. Third-party explainer blogs on these flows were cross-checked against each other and treated cautiously where they disagreed (e.g. Username-Password's exact deprecation status) -- the guide hedges with 'discouraged'/'current guidance steers away from' rather than asserting it is fully removed.
